description:
Port VNodeCompiler.assign_and_emit and its dep-collection helpers to walk vnode-emitting AST instead of Phoenix.LiveView.Engine.live_to_iodata-emitting AST.

Today the walker looks for live_to_iodata(expr) call sites to wrap with memo_at; under vnode IR the dynamic values appear as bare expressions in element children or attr values. New 'where does dynamic value appear' predicate needed.

Event handlers: register_event_handler(handler) calls today appear naked; under vnode IR they appear inside element attrs as {on_click: handler}. Rewrite to {on_click: {:wire_ref, event_at(N, handler)}}.

## Files
- lib/filament/vnode_compiler.ex (assign_and_emit, do_walk, emit_if_needed, compute_deps)

## Acceptance
- Reactive scope inference (Item 1b) still works under vnode IR.
- Stale-closure memoization tests pass (lib/filament/.../memoization tests).
- event_handler indexing remains stable across renders.
title: Phase 1.4.5: assign_and_emit (memo_at, event_at) over vnode-emitting AST
